# Code map (generated by `node tools/codemap.mjs`; don't edit by hand)

One line per file: purpose, (line count), exports and routes as name:line. Open files at these lines with Read offset/limit
instead of reading whole files. Regenerate after adding, removing or renaming files or exports.
